neighbours.label: the verb right after imperative 'go' ('go do', 'go buy', 'go have')
fire: Stop complaining and go clean your room before dinner.
If you love mysteries, please go read this book tonight.
Mom told me to go wash the dishes right now.
You look exhausted, so go take a nap for an hour.
Honestly, just go ask the teacher if you are confused.
The coach yelled at us to go grab some water.
Don't wait for me, go eat your lunch while it's warm.
Leave me alone and go bother your brother instead.
